meta.scope: Correct five inherited S788 author given names against NLM and publisher-deposited metadata

records.title: Effective Relief of Pain and Associated Symptoms With Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation System: Preliminary Results of the Avalon Study

decisions.notes: Official PubMed PMID 28922517 author abstract checked 2026-09-28: exact 3/6-month back/leg ≥50% and ≥80% relief proportions copied with interim 51-trialed/36-implanted context. The article is abstract-only in this pass. Registered AVALON endpoint includes feedback-mode programmability, distinct from patient pain scores; no randomized comparison, visit-specific responder denominator or patient ECAP-to-pain linkage is established. Author list corrected against the NLM EFetch primary record and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata on 2026-09-28; five inherited given names were erroneous. Interim AVALON sample remains 51 trialed/36 implanted, distinct from the mature 70/50 cohort.
